purpose: Define the local release gates that must be checked before a PILAR sprint is considered ready for merge/deploy.

gates.title: Git working tree is clean before release decision
gates.expected: No modified, staged or untracked files. A fallback message such as CLEAN is acceptable.
gates.rationale: Prevents hidden local changes, untracked patch files or generated artifacts from being omitted or accidentally bundled.

gates.title: Full non-writing agent ecosystem gate passes
gates.expected: Command exits with code 0 and prints OK agent ecosystem gate completed.
gates.rationale: Confirms Research, Eval, Guardrails, Observability and Report QA foundations are still healthy.

gates.title: TypeScript compile check passes
gates.rationale: A sprint cannot be release-ready while the TypeScript program is broken.

gates.title: Production build passes
gates.command: { rm -rf .next && npm run debug:sweep && npm run build; } 2>&1 | tee last-run.log
gates.expected: Build completes successfully. Existing warnings may remain if already known and non-blocking.
gates.rationale: The release decision must be based on full build evidence, not only small validators.

gates.title: Agent health snapshot check mode passes
gates.rationale: Gives a release-oriented summary of local agent ecosystem health without changing generated artifacts.

gates.title: Eval readiness report passes
gates.expected: Eval readiness exits 0. Generated readiness artifact may be updated intentionally.
gates.rationale: Confirms the eval seed set is structurally ready.

gates.title: Eval coverage check passes
gates.expected: Coverage check exits 0. Warnings are allowed in v0.1 if documented.
gates.rationale: Confirms eval coverage can be summarized without rewriting artifacts.

gates.title: Research Agent checks pass
gates.expected: Topic registry, registry-to-memo coverage and memo quality checks pass.
gates.rationale: Confirms Research Agent source material remains coherent.

gates.title: Guardrail reason-code registry validates
gates.rationale: Confirms future guardrail reason codes are still controlled.

gates.title: Observability event taxonomy validates
gates.rationale: Confirms observability events remain valid and compatible with current validator.

gates.title: Report QA check registry validates
gates.expected: Report QA registry exits 0. Warnings are allowed in v0.1 if documented.
gates.rationale: Confirms report QA checklist definitions remain valid.

gates.title: Runtime smoke test is required when app/runtime files changed
gates.condition: Required when app/, lib/runtime, report rendering, upload flow, API routes or visible UI are changed.
gates.expected: Relevant page or flow opens without runtime crash.
gates.rationale: Static checks do not prove runtime UI/report flows work.

gates.title: New PILAR run is required for prompt/report-output changes
gates.command: Create a new PILAR run using the relevant regression prompt.
gates.condition: Required when agent prompts, report model, generated report text or controller/report-output logic changes.
gates.expected: Evidence must come from a new run, not old stored database output.
gates.rationale: Old database reports do not prove new prompt/report-output behavior.

gates.title: Norwegian and English/AISC regression required for i18n changes
gates.command: Run one Norwegian Eurocode prompt and one English/AISC prompt.
gates.condition: Required when locale, displayLanguage, shell labels, role labels, report language, DOCX/PDF labels or agent language prompts change.
gates.expected: Norwegian remains Norwegian; international shell remains English; AISC mode does not invent verified table values.
gates.rationale: Language fixes must not break Norwegian mode or AISC safety.

gates.title: Generated artifacts are reviewed before commit
gates.expected: Only intended generated artifacts changed, or generated diffs are restored before commit.
gates.rationale: Readiness and health commands can rewrite markdown artifacts; this must be intentional.
